notes.title: Build (0.10.9) - Earth update
notes.notes:
[p]Today, we are introducing a reskinned version of Grim’s map. Going back to its root, Grim will now be experienced on Earth. Grim started development years ago, as a passion project by its one and only dev - Spoonfed. Back in the days, closed testing happened on this planet - Earth. A lot of memories were created and today, we are moving back to Earth to enhance your experience as a player. [/p][p][/p][h3]Why changing the map? [/h3][p]Technically, we are keeping the same map layout, but reskinned it to Earth. Mars is a very monotone planet in its color palette. On top of that, it creates a challenging environment that is very POI focused due to the oxygen management and resources location. We believe that Earth is a much more user-friendly approach to a genre that is already very challenging.[/p][p][/p][h3]What does that mean for Mars?[/h3][p]We decided to part way with Mars. The reason is that we need to focus our effort on a single map at the time given the scale of the team. We believe there is more potential to the Earth version, so we will focus on it for the foreseeable future.[/p][p][/p][h3]What does that mean for the future?[/h3][p]While we don’t have a public roadmap to share, we did tease a few items on the discord (join us! Link below). They are still being worked on and we will share progress on our discord when anything is getting close to being released. Remember that this is a single dev effort, so things may take time. But we are committed to our vision of Grim VR.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you appreciate this new map as much as we did during the testing. [/p][p]Join our community on Discord to share your thoughts, see features before they are out, find a group and/or get help and tips! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GrimVR"]discord.gg/GrimVR[/url][/p][p]

notes.title: Build 0.8.9 - Quality of life update and weekly wipe
notes.notes:
[h2]Server Wipe and Quality of Life update[/h2]
The servers were wiped on February 06. We also pushed a quality of life update to the game including some of the most requested features from our community - feel free to join it to stay updated and interact with us! discord.gg/grimvr

[b]Build 0.8.9 [/b]
[list]
[*] Added Supply Signal to item database 
[*] Added Barbeque Grill to item database 
[*] Added a toggle crouch option 
[*] Network optimizations to crouching 
[*] Fixed player sometimes getting stuck in crouch 
[*] Fixed radial menus causing player to turn or crouch when selecting a radial option 
[*] Fixed angular velocity on thrown items 
[*] Fixed Oil Refinery not producing charcoal when on and empty 
[*] Fixed a crash in the Main Menu level 
[*] Map now auto zooms on player when opened 
[*] Map can now be opened by long pressing the inventory button 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could loot through walls under certain conditions 
[*] Moved inventory HUD closer to player 
[*] Added a haptic effect when reaching over shoulder for inventory 
[*] Increased group member name plate distance 
[*] Group name plate now removes text after a set distance and scales the indicator dot 
[*] Adjusted Holo Sight and Handmade Sight aiming reticles 
[*] Fixed projectiles being destroyed outside of max damage range
[/list]

notes.title: Mission directive update 2 - Server improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Update 0.8.6[/b]
Bullet point at the end of the notes

[b]Server fixes[/b]
We are thrilled to announce that we have successfully optimized our servers in a first pass, resulting in significantly improved performance! We released the update 24 hours ago and have closely monitored the results before sharing this update and we hope that we'll be in safer waters going forward. We are continuously looking into ways to optimize and provide our users a better experience.

Now is the perfect time to return to Mars, explore the planet, and make new friends (or rivals)!

We are still working on a tutorial, but until it is ready, we got a selection of guides from great content creators :
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwmCLzT8SfXiH-bCqYYdD5jIiAUesGtLd

Our community has also been working on a wiki for you to get you started : https://grimvr.fandom.com/wiki/Grim_Wiki 

[b]Build 0.8.6[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed toggle grip setting preventing clients from dropping Custom SMG and F1 Grenade
[*] Fixed condition reduction on tools being too high against trees, wood piles, and nodes
[*] Network Optimizations for AI
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause server performance degradation over time
[/list]

notes.title: Mission directive update 1
notes.notes:
[h3]Martians, thank you for your support.[/h3]

Yesterday, January 16th 2025, many of you bought a trip to Mars. For most of you, while the landing was rough, the journey was enjoyable despite some obvious unanticipated challenges. For others, it was not exactly what they expected when buying their ticket.

Our resources are currently focusing on improving the stability of the server to make sure we can all share the love we have for the game on a more stable ground. We will be monitoring the servers performances over the weekend and we will keep doing so until we get to a point where we feel comfortable with the servers.

An additional feedback we received is the lack of a tutorial. Rest assured, we are on it! While the content creators are doing an amazing job covering the basics of the game, we have been working on an in-game tutorial. We cannot wait to introduce it to you all.

If you have feedback or have a question to ask, please join our discord community at https://discord.com/invite/grimvr . Our staff and players will be happy to assist you.

Launching a game can be challenging, let alone an early access with high expectations. We want to take a minute to thank you all for the support. Our community has grown rapidly over the past 24h and we have met and interacted with thousands of players. Most of you have been extremely supportive and patient

Our trip on Mars is far from over. And together, we will build the best VR survival game on Mars.
Thank you all.

[previewyoutube=NK3uJNcLMCc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Build 0.8.3[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when not accepting microphone permissions on quest standalone
[*] Fixed a crash on Steam VR when launching the game while steam is offline
[*] Increased the max condition of the starting rock
[*] Fixed server browser not updating completely on its first load
[*] Network optimizations for foliage and node respawning updates
[/list]

We also added a server called [b]"[US] Spoon stress test server"[/b] to test server performance. [u]THIS SERVER IS A TEST SERVER[/u]. Please be aware that this server might reset, wipe or be taken down at any moment. This is a server to monitor performances. If you live in the US, want to contribute to the test and don't mind losing your progress, please join.
